text: The Patriots are heading into Week 5 donning throwback uniforms for their home clash against the 3-1 Raiders at Gillette Stadium, riding momentum from Drake Maye's AFC Offensive Player of the Week performance in last Sunday's 29-26 comeback victory over Buffalo—a win that lifted New England from 1-3 back to 2-2 and sparked all manner of speculation about whether the team has truly turned a corner. However, the road ahead presents immediate complications: Rhamondre Stevenson is dealing with an injury that's creating questions at running back, and while the Patriots managed to shut down the Bills' Dalton Kincaid in Week 4, they'll face a formidable 1-2 tight end punch in Las Vegas with Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer looming as major threats. The narrative around this squad remains decidedly mixed—cautious optimism at best—as beat writers grapple with whether New England's dramatic Week 4 rally, alongside similar comebacks by the Rams and Cowboys, represents genuine resurgence or clever repackaging of still-unresolved problems.
